fact: The African Union Commission says a workshop in Kinshasa on 12-14 May 2026 supports the DRC in assessing and strengthening its Education Management Information System.

The World Bank restructuring paper says DIGE carried out data collection for the 2022/23 school year using the new automated data collection and transmission system via the e-SIGE-DRC application, with data dated 9 June 2023 covering the 10 project provinces.
